scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Asian drama, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Runtime budget alignment: provider now receives the full 20s app runtime instead of the 10s descriptor default, so the existing bounded title/detail/video/subtitle pipeline is not killed before it can return valid links.

scrapers.name: OneTouchTV
scrapers.description: Asian drama, anime, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Runtime budget alignment: provider now receives the full 20s app runtime instead of the 10s descriptor default; alias searches and detail verification remain parallel and bounded.

scrapers.name: HDHub4u
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Discovery Rebuild V1: raw TMDB title is searched before season/year variants; current and legacy result-card layouts are parsed; noisy release strings are normalized before scoring so valid title matches are not lost. Existing QuickJS recursion/parser hotfixes remain.

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: Movie and TV streams from the current MovieBox H5 web API mirror pool
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Discovery Rebuild V1: MovieBox title scoring now strips season/year/quality noise before alias matching, TV year mismatch is a soft preference instead of a hard penalty, and more TMDB aliases are covered without increasing the mirror fan-out.

scrapers.name: 4KHDHub
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Discovery Rebuild V1: raw aliases are searched before year/season variants, current movie-card and legacy layouts are both parsed, and noisy release metadata is removed before title scoring. Existing memory-scope guard remains.

scrapers.name: PencuriMovie
scrapers.description: Malaysia and Indonesia movie and TV streams with multi-server playback
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Discovery Rebuild V1: broader alias discovery, generic canonical title-anchor parsing, cleaned title scoring, and landing-page fallback before declaring a title missing. Existing multi-server extraction is unchanged.

scrapers.name: MSM21
scrapers.description: Malay subtitle movie and TV streams using Zeta player multi-server extraction
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Discovery Rebuild V1: supports both legacy display-item and current ml-item/canonical archive cards, searches more TMDB aliases, cleans release noise before scoring, and falls back to the TV/movie archive before declaring a title missing.

scrapers.name: CineMode
scrapers.description: Movie and TV stream resolver for the CineMode streaming PWA
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1: primary TMDB title plus one highest-priority alternate title fallback, preserving the bounded WebView runtime.
